run.name: Millicom International Cellular SA
run.title: CP-OS host session (TIGO)
run.summary: Millicom can comfortably service its debt from current earnings, but acquisitions pushed leverage to 2.53x and left liquidity and creditor protections less visible than the earnings suggest. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is MILLICOM INTERNATIONAL CELLULAR SA.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Gross debt 8,648 and management net debt 7,983 over sum of four quarters of Adjusted EBITDA 3,734; excludes lease liabilities, not pro forma for Coltel (consolidated from Feb 6, 2026); lower than management's 2.53x, which uses EBITDA after lease deductions and a pro forma adjustment

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 2,749 over finance charges paid net 558 (interest on debt 409 and on leases 176 less interest received 27 as the cash flow statement prints them); includes lease interest

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents on the balance sheet; excludes restricted cash of 31; about 78% is held in U.S. dollars; split between holding company and subsidiaries not supplied

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Revolving facility status, covenant levels and debt documents are not available for the latest quarter, and pro forma figures for the acquired businesses are missing.
CP-1 main limitation: Undrawn facilities, covenant levels and debt by instrument are not supplied for the latest quarter.
